title: Created PLAN-PHASE2.md as Repository SSOT — Formalized Phase 2 Specification with Actionable Roadmap
body: The user formalized the Phase 2 specification by creating `PLAN-PHASE2.md` as a committed repository document (sibling to the existing `PLAN.md` for Phase 1). This transition from temporary planning files to repo-committed SSOT (Single Source of Truth) signals that the Phase 2 vision is locked and ready to communicate to the team. The roadmap uses markdown checkboxes to make progress trackable. Explicit timing gate: Phase 2 does not start until Phase 1 dogfeeding feedback is captured into `docs/PHASE1-FEEDBACK.md`, ensuring that critical UX gaps or bugs discovered during teammate testing are fixed in v0.1.x patches before committing to Phase 2 scope. The plan includes all strategic decisions (git-native distribution, JSONL format, redaction, auto-lifecycle on PR merge, optional auto-inject, conscious scope discipline vs Lore's surface area) and verification checkpoints (two-dev E2E, GitHub Action E2E, privacy/safety tests, adoption metric).
author: Nguyễn Văn Rum (VSF-QTVHNTDVX-PMGTCC)
